Measure, choose, install

A simple process with no surprises. Pick a step to see what happens.

We measure up

We visit, check the subfloor and measure every room and stair so you get an accurate, fixed quote.

  • Free, no-obligation visit
  • Subfloor and stair checks
  • Written quote with nothing hidden

You choose

See real samples in your own light. We help you compare colour, pile, wear rating and budget.

  • Samples brought to your home
  • Honest advice on what suits each room
  • Underlay and finishing options explained

We install

Our fitters prepare, cut and lay your floor, then clear away and leave the room ready to use.

  • Careful prep and clean, tight fitting
  • Furniture and waste handled with care
  • Final walk-through with you
